depicts

  • CURIE: gmeow:depicts
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/depicts
  • Category: property
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/documents

Relates an image (MediaObject) to an entity it depicts — the flat 80%-case shortcut, subproperty of gmeow:isAbout. Non-functional: an image may depict many entities. Promote to a gmeow:DepictionUsage relator when the context, audience, period, confidence, or evidence of the depiction must be recorded.

Structure

Property shape: object property; gmeow:MediaObject -> gmeow:Entity Sub-property of: gmeow:isAbout

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:depicts from gmeow:MediaObject to gmeow:Entity when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

Common Companion Terms

gmeow:isAbout, gmeow:MediaObject, gmeow:Entity
